name: Portreeve Brack
title: Portreeve of Saltmere
examine: A back built by oars and a face built by weather. He reads the mere the way clerks read ledgers, and trusts it less.
lines: Wind's backing south. Boats in by dusk.
Dock room is for working boats. You want to stand and stare, the quay's free.
Four boats, one bad year. Read the stone by the light before you ask me about it.
